publication.edition: Greek text with English translation and commentary by W. Rhys Roberts

verification.verification_notes: Edition verified via Internet Archive advanced search (Roberts, Macmillan, 1910). Argument confirmed: a systematic treatise on the melody of prose and the choice and arrangement of sounds.

limitations: Greek quantitative rhythm is not reproducible in English; the transferable part is the principle, not the specific rhythms.

copyright.notes: 1910 translation in the public domain; no text reproduced.
